subject: Pinespring: staged team activation, new keys & term alignment
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@pinespringhealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@pinespringhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pinespring: staged team activation, new keys & term alignment

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Based on the product team's roadmap and the apps inventory you sent, it sounds like Pinespring is ready to onboard three additional squads over Q1. I wanted to outline a pragmatic, low-friction plan that aligns timing with your renewal so we can:

- Add per-project API keys for the three new apps (mobile triage, intake forms, care coordinator bot)
- Stage activations over two waves (Week 1: triage + intake; Week 3: coordinator bot)
- Keep current pricing/committed units aligned with renewal credits so procurement can sign one amendment rather than multiple PO changes

Quick asks from your side so we can finalize the amendment:
1) Confirm the final list of apps (I attached a working CSV).
2) Who from procurement should I loop into the contract conversation?
3) Any hard constraints on start dates for each wave?

I've attached the PS-application-inventory.csv for reference and sketched an amendment template that preserves your committed units while adding a staggered key allocation. If this approach looks good I can pull together a formal amendment and pricing options for dedicated capacity vs. overage protection.

Thanks — talk soon,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0192
From: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@pinespringhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@pinespringhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinespring: staged team activation, new keys & term alignment

Tessa, thanks — this plan maps well to what the teams discussed. A few clarifications from my side:

- The apps CSV looks right; we should also include the internal SRE flag for each app (Sofia, can you add that column?).
- Procurement contact is Jorge Ramos (jorge.ramos@pinespringhealth.com). He prefers consolidated amendments rather than many small PO changes.
- For timing: we want Wave 1 to go live the week of Jan 8 and Wave 2 the week of Jan 22. That gives engineering two ramp weeks.

Two questions for Redwood:
1) For per-project keys, can you advise on a key rotation policy that works with our SSO and KMS?
2) If we need dedicated capacity for the coordinator bot, can Redwood provide an estimated per-hour unit cost vs. pay-as-you-go?

Sofia — cc'd — can you confirm the SRE columns?

Appreciate it,
Alex
Director of Product, Pinespring Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 Dec 2028 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pinespring: staged team activation, new keys & term alignment

Ben / Lauren — forwarding Pinespring's timeline and asks. Key points: Wave 1 (Jan 8) and Wave 2 (Jan 22). Procurement wants a single consolidated amendment (contact: jorge.ramos@pinespringhealth.com).

What I need from you both:
- Ben: draft two pricing options for the coordinator bot traffic (1) dedicated capacity monthly commit vs (2) burstable reserve + overage protection. Include the expected token rate and per-hour cost estimates.
- Lauren: legal — is there a standard amendment template we can reuse to add the three projects and preserve existing committed units? Any gotchas around term alignment if we extend a quarter to sync renewal?

I've attached the inventory CSV and will add Pinespring's HubSpot deal link to the final doc. Goal: have a working amendment draft by Wed (Dec 6) to share with Jorge and their procurement team.

Thanks —
Tessa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Dec 2028 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pinespring: staged team activation, new keys & term alignment

Nice, thanks Tessa. Drafted two options and attached a short SKU/pricing summary and an amendment skeleton: RWD-amendment-draft-v1.pdf (redlines to follow once we lock dates). High level:

Option A — Dedicated pod commit
- Monthly commit: 32k tokens/sec equivalent; flat monthly fee.
- Best predictable unit cost for coordinator bot peak windows.

Option B — Burstable reserve + overage
- Lower monthly base commit, with burst capacity billed at per-hour rate when threshold exceeded.
- Easier for them if traffic is spiky and they don't want to commit permanently.

Action items: Lauren, please confirm if the amendment language to preserve committed units for existing teams but add per-project key buckets is standard. If we need term alignment (extend their current term by one month to match staggered activation), mention any billing implications.

Ben
Director, Customer Success (Sales Ops) | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@pinespringhealth.com>, Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@pinespringhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Dec 2028 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinespring: staged team activation, new keys & term alignment

Alex / Sofia — attaching the draft amendment and two pricing options Ben prepared. Summary and recommended path:

- We propose Option A (Dedicated pod commit) for the coordinator bot given predictable peak windows; this minimizes per-token cost and gives reserved capacity for scheduled waves.
- We'll add three per-project API keys and an SRE-designated metadata flag for governance; Sofia, that metadata will be applied to help with rotation/monitoring.
- To align with your procurement preference, we'll submit a single consolidated amendment that extends the term by one month so activation weeks fall inside the renewed period (no double billing).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm procurement contact (Jorge) and whether he wants the amendment via DocuSign or as a PDF for internal routing.
2) Confirm Wave 1 start: 2029-01-08 and Wave 2 start: 2029-01-22.
3) Sofia: confirm SRE column and whether we should enable automated key rotation tied to your KMS (we recommend yes).

Attachments: PS-application-inventory.csv, RWD-amendment-draft-v1.pdf

If you confirm the above this week, Ben and I will finalize the amendment and I will send to Jorge by Dec 8.

Best,
Tessa
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Navarro <alex.navarro@pinespringhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@pinespringhealth.com>, Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@pinespringhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pinespring: staged team activation, new keys & term alignment

Tessa — all good on our side. Jorge prefers DocuSign. Sofia confirmed she added the SRE flag to the inventory and says automated rotation tied to our KMS is preferred.

Wave 1: 2029-01-08
Wave 2: 2029-01-22

Please proceed with the single consolidated amendment and send via DocuSign to jorge.ramos@pinespringhealth.com. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

—Alex
Director of Product, Pinespring Health
